heatshield.note: no position stops out tighter than this floor — sits through heat for the bounce

post_wipe_quiet.note: engine intentionally quiet after a wipe — no trades until the window elapses, so the clean run starts from a known baseline

exit_policy: target (win) or heatshield floor only — timeouts removed

feed_integrity.what: names whose recent feed shows a >=6% move immediately reversed by >=50% (a stale round-trip) — a real market does not do that; these are bad-data feeds, excluded from trading so they cannot book fake P&L. A real move that HOLDS is not flagged.

note: Internal paper sim, 4 independent books (crypto/stock/metal/energy). Ghosts excluded; fees = max(0.2%, 2x noise floor). Metal/energy stay empty until their data feed is wired (metals_samples.json / energy_samples.json).
